column9: Constructs complex, well-scaled free-body diagrams for multi-force situations and communicates with precise scientific language and units. column15: Uses diagrams to model balanced and unbalanced forces with directions and labels. column18: Creates simple force diagrams with directional arrows and labels some forces as push/pull. Outlines how forces can change motion or shape in a familiar situation.
